ns2:course.label: Special Topics German Studies
ns2:course.description: Intensive study of restricted topics in German language, literature, and culture. May be repeated as topics vary to a maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Three years of college German or equivalent.
